title.en: Zheng Chenggong · a Ming loyalist across the strait
title.zh: 郑成功 · 跨海的明朝效忠者

summary.en: Zheng Chenggong built his resistance to Qing rule around coastal strongholds rather than an inland capital. Xiamen and Kinmen became bases in 1650; from this maritime setting he carried the Ming loyalist struggle into Taiwan. His forces landed there in 1661 and challenged the Dutch colonial government. The episode survives in competing memories: a Japanese memorial museum follows his cross-border family history, while the former Dutch governor Frederick Coyett later published a defence of his own conduct. Zheng died in Taiwan in 1662. Reading these accounts together reveals how a military campaign became a story repeatedly retold by communities on different shores.
summary.zh: 郑成功的抗清事业以沿海据点为依托。1650年，厦门与金门成为他的基地；他随后把效忠明朝的战争带到台湾，军队于1661年登陆，与荷兰殖民当局作战。这段经历留下了不同立场的叙述：日本的纪念馆着重介绍他的跨海家世，荷兰末任台湾长官揆一则在事后出版著作为自身辩护。郑成功于1662年在台湾去世。将这些材料并读，可以看见一场战争如何成为海峡两岸及海外社群不断重述的历史。

title.en: Kangxi Emperor · ruling through travel and images
title.zh: 康熙帝 · 巡行、图像与统治

labelI18n.zh: 北京，帝国及现代国家首都

summary.en: The Kangxi emperor inherited the throne as a child in 1661; the reign era bearing his name began the following year. His long reign combined warfare and consolidation with patronage of scholarship and practical interest in governing resources. Southern inspection tours made imperial authority visible beyond Beijing. On the first tour in 1684 and the second in 1689, travel connected the court with prosperous regions whose cooperation mattered to Qing rule. Wang Hui and his workshop turned the second tour into handscrolls. Their ordered landscapes and ceremonial encounters offer evidence of how the court wished its presence to be seen, as well as glimpses of cities and livelihoods.
summary.zh: 康熙帝于1661年幼年即位，次年才开始使用“康熙”年号。他在位期间通过战争巩固统治，也赞助学术，关注治理所需的资源。南巡使北京以外的居民能够看见皇权的到来。1684年的首次南巡与1689年的第二次南巡，把宫廷同对清朝统治十分重要的江南地区联系起来。王翚及其画家团队将第二次南巡绘成长卷。画中的城市、生产活动和仪式既保存了历史景观，也表现了宫廷希望臣民如何看待皇帝。

title.en: Lin Zexu · administration and the opium crisis
title.zh: 林则徐 · 政务与鸦片危机

location.label: Guangzhou, Pearl River political and trading centre

labelI18n.en: Guangzhou, Pearl River political and trading centre
labelI18n.zh: 广州，珠江流域的政治与贸易中心

summary.en: Lin Zexu approached the opium trade as an official responsible for public order, revenue and livelihoods. Before the confrontation at Guangzhou, his career included examination success in 1811, provincial administration and river conservancy. Appointed imperial commissioner at the end of 1838, he sought to stop opium consumption and trafficking, using both treatment measures and severe penalties. In 1839 he required foreign merchants to surrender opium and promise to end the trade. The dispute drew together addiction, commercial profit, Chinese jurisdiction and British imperial power. His career therefore opens a wider question than an individual’s courage: how could an administrative campaign govern a trade sustained across imperial borders?
summary.zh: 林则徐从官员维护秩序、财政与民生的职责出发处理鸦片问题。在广州的冲突之前，他已于1811年考中进士，历任地方官，并参与河工。1838年底受命为钦差大臣后，他试图同时制止吸食与贩运，既提出戒治措施，也施行严厉处罚。1839年，他要求外国商人交出鸦片并承诺停止交易。由此产生的争端把成瘾、商业利益、中国司法权与英国帝国力量交织在一起。他的经历引出一个超越个人勇气的问题：行政禁令如何面对跨越帝国边界的贸易网络？

title.en: Zeng Guofan · an army and a family archive
title.zh: 曾国藩 · 军队与家书

labelI18n.zh: 长沙，湖南军事组织中心

summary.en: Zeng Guofan’s career joined the world of the examination scholar to the emergency politics of civil war. After becoming a jinshi in 1838, he served at court. Returning to Hunan for family mourning, he entered the campaign against the Taiping and organized the Xiang Army in the 1850s. His forces’ capture of Nanjing in 1864 helped end the Taiping state. Alongside this military record, letters to his son preserve another register: study, family duties and advice issued while campaigning. Reading the letters beside the army’s history reveals how elite education and personal networks sustained an official whose authority expanded far beyond ordinary civil administration.
summary.zh: 曾国藩的生涯把科举士人的生活与内战中的非常政治联系起来。他于1838年中进士，入朝任职；后来回湖南守丧，转而投入对太平军的作战，并在1850年代组织湘军。其部队于1864年攻下南京，促成太平天国政权的覆亡。军事记录之外，他给儿子的信呈现了另一种声音：读书、家族责任，以及军务之中持续写下的教诲。将家书与战争史并读，可以理解士人教育和私人关系如何支撑一位权力超出常规文官职掌的官员。

title.en: Zuo Zongtang · regional armies and imperial priorities
title.zh: 左宗棠 · 地方军队与帝国防务

labelI18n.zh: 兰州，西北行政的代表性中心

summary.en: Zuo Zongtang rose through warfare rather than success at the highest civil examination. In 1860 he recruited forces against the Taiping, then held senior offices in Zhejiang and Fujian. His assignment to Shaanxi and Gansu in 1866 shifted his career toward the northwest, where campaigns against Muslim rebels and rival powers expanded Qing control. The struggle involved decisions about imperial resources as well as battlefield command: Zuo argued for western campaigns while Li Hongzhang emphasized coastal defence. Later service took him back toward Fujian, where he died in 1885. His career links provincial military organization to competing visions of what the Qing state should defend and finance.
summary.zh: 左宗棠并未通过最高一级科举考试，而是借战事进入权力中心。1860年，他招募部队对抗太平军，随后出任浙江、福建的重要官职。1866年调任陕甘总督，使其事业转向西北；此后的镇压与征战扩大了清朝在该地区的控制。这些战争不仅涉及指挥，也涉及财政取舍：他主张为西部军事行动筹款，李鸿章则强调海防。晚年左宗棠再次赴福建任事，并于1885年在那里去世。他的经历将地方军队的成长同清廷究竟应保卫何处、投入何种资源的争论联系起来。

title.en: Sun Yat-sen · revolution through overseas networks
title.zh: 孙中山 · 海外网络中的革命

location.label: Guangzhou, Pearl River political and trading centre

labelI18n.en: Guangzhou, Pearl River political and trading centre
labelI18n.zh: 广州，珠江流域的政治与贸易中心

summary.en: Sun Yat-sen’s revolution depended on people and money moving between places. The Revive China Society, founded in Honolulu in 1894, and the Revolutionary Alliance formed in Tokyo in 1905 connected overseas supporters, students and activists. Publications, donations and bonds helped sustain a campaign repeatedly interrupted by failed uprisings. Sun became provisional president at Nanjing in January 1912 and soon relinquished the office during negotiations with Yuan Shikai. The republic remained contested. In Guangzhou, Sun continued trying to build a political and military base; the Whampoa Military Academy opened in 1924 with Soviet and Chinese Communist assistance. His career makes overseas organizing central to the history of the Chinese republic.
summary.zh: 孙中山的革命依靠人员和资金在不同地点之间流动。1894年成立于檀香山的兴中会，以及1905年在东京成立的同盟会，把海外支持者、学生和活动家联系起来。报刊、捐款与债券支撑了屡遭起义失败打击的事业。1912年1月，孙中山在南京就任临时大总统，不久在与袁世凯的协商中交出职位。共和国的制度与权力仍受到争夺。此后，他在广州继续建立政治和军事基础，1924年黄埔军校在苏联及中国共产党协助下开办。他的经历说明，海外组织活动是中国共和历史的重要组成部分。

title.en: Chiang Kai-shek · military power and authoritarian rule
title.zh: 蒋介石 · 军事权力与威权统治

labelI18n.zh: 台北，1949年后的总统政府所在地

summary.en: Chiang Kai-shek’s power grew from the military institutions of the Nationalist revolution. Commandant of Whampoa in 1924, he led the Northern Expedition from 1926 and later headed the Nationalist government. War against Japan and the renewed civil war reshaped his rule. After military defeat and the government’s relocation to Taiwan in 1949, he resumed the presidency in Taipei in 1950. Official chronologies emphasize state building; Taiwan’s National Human Rights Museum documents the coercive machinery behind authoritarian rule, including military trials of civilians and Chiang’s intervention in sentences. Holding these records together connects the commander’s political survival with the experiences of people persecuted under his government.
summary.zh: 蒋介石的权力从国民革命的军事制度中成长。1924年出任黄埔军校校长后，他于1926年领导北伐，后来主持国民政府。对日战争与再次爆发的国共内战改变了他的统治。1949年军事失败、政府迁台后，他于1950年在台北恢复总统职务。官方年表强调国家建设，台湾国家人权博物馆则记录威权统治的强制机制，包括以军事审判处理平民，以及蒋介石亲自干预刑期。将这些材料并读，可以把军事领导人的政治延续与其政府之下遭受迫害者的经历联系起来。

title.en: Mao Zedong · revolution, state and mass campaigns
title.zh: 毛泽东 · 革命、国家与群众运动

labelI18n.zh: 北京，帝国及现代国家首都

summary.en: Mao Zedong moved from revolutionary organizer and guerrilla commander to chairman of the Communist Party’s Politburo in 1943. After the establishment of the People’s Republic in 1949, he and his colleagues transformed landholding, industry and everyday political life. These changes expanded state power while campaigns imposed severe human costs. The Great Leap Forward brought catastrophic suffering; conflict within the leadership then fed into the Cultural Revolution, launched in 1966. Mao encouraged mass mobilization and a personal cult that helped turn political disagreements into persecution. His death in 1976 closed this phase of personal rule. Understanding his career requires examining both revolutionary institution building and the people harmed by the state’s campaigns.
summary.zh: 毛泽东从革命组织者和游击战争指挥者逐步成为中共领导人，1943年出任中央政治局主席。1949年中华人民共和国成立后，他与同僚推动土地制度、工业和日常政治生活的改造。这些变化扩大了国家权力，政治运动也造成沉重的人道代价。大跃进带来灾难性苦难，领导层的冲突随后卷入1966年发动的文化大革命。毛泽东鼓励群众动员，个人崇拜又使政治分歧转化为迫害。1976年他的去世结束了这一阶段的个人统治。理解他的生涯，需要同时考察革命建制与国家运动中受害者的经历。

title.en: Deng Xiaoping · market reform and political limits
title.zh: 邓小平 · 市场改革与政治边界

labelI18n.zh: 北京，帝国及现代国家首都

summary.en: Deng Xiaoping’s post-Mao authority rested on decades inside the Communist Party, including service as general secretary from 1956. Purged during the Cultural Revolution and restored to senior office, he emerged as China’s effective leader by the end of 1978. Economic reform widened the role of markets and incentives and changed daily livelihoods. Political power, however, remained under party control. Deng opposed liberalization that threatened that control and supported the military suppression of the 1989 democracy movement. His career brings two developments into the same frame: changes that increased economic opportunity and a leadership willing to use armed force against political dissent. Neither can be separated from the history of the reform period.
summary.zh: 邓小平在毛泽东之后取得的权威，建立在数十年的中共资历之上，其中包括1956年起担任中央总书记。文革中被打倒、随后重返高层后，他到1978年底成为实际最高领导人。经济改革扩大了市场与激励的作用，改变了日常生计；政治权力则继续由党掌握。邓小平反对威胁这一控制的政治自由化，并支持1989年以军队镇压民主运动。他的生涯同时呈现两种发展：经济机会的扩大，以及领导层用武力压制政治异议的选择。两者都属于改革时期的历史。

title.en: Chen Sheng · a conscript becomes a king

labelI18n.zh: 大泽乡地区，起事的代表地点

summary.en: Chen Sheng enters Sima Qian’s history as a hired farm worker with ambitions beyond his assigned place. In 209 BCE, he and Wu Guang turned a group of men sent to frontier service into an armed challenge to Qin rule. Taking Chen, the insurgents proclaimed a restored Chu kingdom with Chen Sheng as king. Their success encouraged other commanders to establish power of their own, making a common rebellion difficult to direct. The biography records both the force of his challenge to inherited rank and the violence of his brief kingship. It offers a story of political possibility whose early promise did not guarantee durable institutions.
summary.zh: 司马迁笔下的陈胜，最初是怀有远大志向的佣耕者。公元前209年，他与吴广把一队被征发戍边的人组织成反抗秦朝的武装。攻占陈地后，起事者建立张楚政权，拥陈胜为王。他的成功推动其他将领另立权力中心，也使共同的反秦事业难以统一指挥。传记既保存了对世袭地位的挑战，也记述其短暂王权中的暴力。这个故事呈现了政治变动的可能，同时说明最初的动员并不能保证制度长久。

title.en: Lü Bu · military talent without a secure coalition
title.zh: 吕布 · 勇力与不稳固的联盟

summary.en: Lü Bu served several competing leaders as the Han court lost control over its armies. He helped Wang Yun kill Dong Zhuo in 192, but their success did not secure the capital: Dong’s former followers drove him out. In 194, a rebellion against Cao Cao gave Lü Bu a base in Yan province. He subsequently moved into the struggles around Liu Bei and Yuan Shu in Xu province. The Records of the Three Kingdoms describes shifting promises, divided commanders and shortages as well as battlefield courage. Cao Cao’s siege in 198 brought these weaknesses together. Lü Bu’s career shows why prowess alone could not hold a coalition or sustain a regional state.
summary.zh: 汉廷失去对军队的控制时，吕布先后依附于相互竞争的领袖。192年，他协助王允杀死董卓，但胜利没有稳住都城，董卓旧部很快将他逐出。194年，反曹操的叛乱使吕布在兖州取得据点。随后，他又卷入徐州刘备与袁术之间的争夺。《三国志》写下的不只有战场勇力，还有反复的承诺、分歧的部将和军粮短缺。198年曹操的围攻使这些弱点集中显现。吕布的经历说明，个人武勇不足以维系联盟或支撑地方政权。

title.en: Yuan Shao · a great family in a fragmented empire
title.zh: 袁绍 · 分裂帝国中的大族

summary.en: Yuan Shao possessed family prestige, followers and a territorial base that made him a leading contender after Han authority fractured. The coalition against Dong Zhuo chose him as its leader in 190. Taking control of Ji province the following year gave his ambitions a stronger foundation. His confrontation with Cao Cao culminated at Guandu in 200, where attacks on supplies and defections helped break his army. The biography preserves disputes among advisers over how to fight; these are also a historian’s explanation of defeat. Yuan restored control over some rebellious cities, but his death in 202 left a succession struggle. Defeat did not end his power immediately, yet it weakened what his sons inherited.
summary.zh: 袁绍拥有家族声望、追随者与领土基础，在汉朝权威瓦解后成为主要竞争者。190年，讨董卓联盟推他为盟主；次年取得冀州，又加强了这一基础。200年，他与曹操在官渡决战，粮运遭袭与部将倒戈促成军队溃败。传记保存了谋士对作战方式的争论，这些记述也承担着史家解释失败的作用。袁绍随后重新控制部分叛离的城邑，但202年的去世引发继承冲突。官渡之败没有立即终结其势力，却削弱了诸子接手的基业。

title.en: Zhang Fei · service, command and harsh discipline

summary.en: Zhang Fei’s biography presents a long association with Liu Bei and Guan Yu, built through shared military service. It credits him with covering Liu Bei’s retreat at Changban and participating in the conquest of the Sichuan basin. Promotion under Liu Bei’s new royal and imperial titles made him a senior figure in the emerging Shu state. The same account links his end to the treatment of his own soldiers: Liu Bei warned against excessive punishment, and subordinates killed Zhang Fei before the campaign against Wu in 221. This is a portrait of command that joins courage to an institutional problem—how a general’s authority depended on the people he disciplined.
summary.zh: 张飞的传记展现了他与刘备、关羽在长期从军中建立的关系。史书将长坂掩护撤退及参与夺取四川盆地的功劳归于他。刘备称王、称帝时给予的晋升，使张飞成为蜀汉形成过程中的高级将领。同一传记也把他的结局同对士卒的待遇联系起来：刘备曾劝止过度处罚，而部下于221年伐吴前杀死张飞。这幅将领画像把勇气与统率问题放在一起：军官的权力，也取决于他如何对待执行命令的人。

title.en: Zhao Yun · guarding people, holding a retreat
title.zh: 赵云 · 护持与有序撤退

summary.en: Zhao Yun’s surviving biography is brief beside the fame later attached to him. It follows a soldier who moved from Gongsun Zan’s service into Liu Bei’s circle and protected Liu Bei’s family during the retreat at Changban. The record then traces appointments in Shu and participation in Zhuge Liang’s northern campaigns. In 228, Zhao Yun and Deng Zhi faced a stronger force while the main army attacked elsewhere. Their operation failed, but Zhao kept his soldiers together during withdrawal; he nevertheless lost rank. His death followed in 229. The account offers a useful distinction between winning a campaign and fulfilling responsibilities within a defeated army.
summary.zh: 与后世声名相比，赵云留存的正史传记篇幅很短。它记载一位从公孙瓒部下进入刘备集团的军人，以及他在长坂撤退时保护刘备家属的经历。随后，传记转向蜀汉任官与诸葛亮北伐。228年，主力向别处进攻时，赵云与邓芝面对兵力更强的对手。行动失利，但赵云在撤退中保持部众完整，仍因此受到降职处分。次年他去世。这段记载使人能够区分两件事：赢得一场战役，以及在失败的军队中履行将领职责。

title.en: Jiang Wei · the choices of a frontier commander
title.zh: 姜维 · 边地将领的抉择

location.label: Tianshui region, Jiang Wei’s early setting

labelI18n.en: Tianshui region, Jiang Wei’s early setting

summary.en: Jiang Wei entered Shu service in 228 after the advance of Zhuge Liang’s army disrupted his position in Tianshui. The Records of the Three Kingdoms preserves differing accounts of that transfer, making it difficult to reduce his choice to a simple declaration of loyalty. He rose to command repeated campaigns against Wei, drawing on familiarity with the northwestern frontier. Defeat at Duangu in 256 exposed the costs of these efforts. During Wei’s invasion in 263, he defended Jiange while Deng Ai approached Chengdu by another line. Liu Shan’s surrender then made continued resistance untenable. Jiang Wei’s career connects strategic ambition with the limited resources and divided decisions of a smaller state.
summary.zh: 228年，诸葛亮军队的推进打乱了姜维在天水的处境，他由此进入蜀汉。《三国志》及裴注保存了不同的归蜀经过，难以将其选择简化为一次单纯的忠诚宣言。他后来利用对西北边地的熟悉，多次率军进攻魏国；256年段谷之败显示了这些行动的代价。263年魏军入侵时，他在剑阁阻击，邓艾却从另一方向逼近成都。刘禅投降后，继续抵抗失去基础。姜维的生涯把战略抱负同一个较小国家的资源限制与决策分歧联系起来。

title.en: Deng Ai · grain, waterways and the conquest of Shu
title.zh: 邓艾 · 军粮、水道与灭蜀

location.label: Shouchun region, military agriculture and transport

labelI18n.en: Shouchun region, military agriculture and transport
labelI18n.zh: 寿春地区，军屯与运输场景

summary.en: Deng Ai’s military career began with practical questions about food and transport. His biography describes experience in agricultural administration and proposals to connect irrigation, settlement and the movement of grain. Canal works in 241 turned those ideas into military infrastructure. Later, he defended Wei’s northwestern frontier against Jiang Wei, including a victory at Duangu in 256. In 263 his army used a difficult approach through the mountains while another Wei force confronted Shu at Jiange. Liu Shan surrendered when Deng Ai reached the Chengdu region. Read together, these episodes make the conquest more than a tale of a daring march: maintaining armies depended on fields, water and organized supplies.
summary.zh: 邓艾的军事业绩始于粮食与运输这样的实际问题。本传记述他从事农业行政，并主张把灌溉、屯田和粮运联系起来。241年的漕渠工程使这些设想成为军事设施。后来，他在西北边境抵御姜维，包括256年段谷获胜。263年，另一支魏军在剑阁牵制蜀军时，邓艾军队由艰险山路进逼成都，促成刘禅投降。将这些经历并读，灭蜀便不只是一段奇袭故事：维持军队所依靠的，还有田地、水源与有组织的供给。

title.en: Huan Wen · campaigns and pressure on the court
title.zh: 桓温 · 征战与朝廷压力

summary.en: Huan Wen’s conquest of Cheng-Han in 347 made him a powerful figure within the Eastern Jin. Control of regional armies allowed a commander far from the capital to influence decisions at court. Northern campaigns brought both achievement and frustration: the expedition of 369 ran short of supplies and ended in defeat. Huan then intervened directly in the succession, deposing an emperor in 371. The Book of Jin presents his ambition through ominous stories and moral judgment, but its account also reveals a structural tension between the dynasty and the armies defending it. His death in 373 left that tension unresolved; the imperial title had survived an extraordinarily powerful minister.
summary.zh: 347年灭成汉之役使桓温成为东晋权势人物。控制地方军队，让一位远离首都的统帅能够影响宫廷决策。北伐既有进展，也有挫折：369年的远征因补给不足而以失败告终。随后，桓温直接干预皇位继承，于371年废立皇帝。《晋书》借预兆故事与道德评价描述其野心，但叙述背后也呈现出一种结构性矛盾：王朝依靠军队自卫，又受到统军者的威胁。373年桓温去世时，这一矛盾仍未解决；皇位则经历了强臣掌权而继续存在。

title.en: Fu Jian · conquest and a coalition’s limits
title.zh: 苻坚 · 征服与联盟的限度

summary.en: Fu Jian became ruler of Former Qin in 357 and built an expanding state around Chang’an. Working with Wang Meng and other advisers, he combined military conquest with offices, schooling and the incorporation of defeated elites. The conquest of Former Yan in 370 brought new territory and people, including families moved into the Guanzhong region. Expansion also produced a difficult problem: armies and leaders incorporated by conquest did not necessarily share a lasting political commitment. In 383 Fu Jian attacked Eastern Jin and suffered defeat at the Fei River. The dynastic histories frame the disaster as a ruler ignoring advice; their account also exposes the strains of governing a large, recently assembled realm.
summary.zh: 苻坚于357年成为前秦统治者，以长安为中心扩张国家。他与王猛等谋臣合作，将军事征服同官制、学校及接纳战败精英结合起来。370年灭前燕后，新的领土与人口进入其统治，其中一些家族被迁往关中。扩张也带来难题：征服所纳入的军队和领袖未必具有持久的政治认同。383年，苻坚进攻东晋，在淝水战败。正史将灾难归结为君主不听劝谏；这些叙述也揭示了治理一个刚刚拼合的大国所承受的压力。

title.en: Xie Xuan · defence and the work of supply
title.zh: 谢玄 · 防御与补给工作

summary.en: Xie Xuan’s appointment to command north of the Yangtze in 377 linked the influence of the Xie family at court with the practical defence of Eastern Jin. His forces helped defeat Fu Jian’s invasion at the Fei River in 383, alongside other commanders whose roles the dynastic history also records. Victory opened an opportunity to advance north. The next phase required more than battlefield success: the biography describes improving waterways to move supplies through difficult terrain. These works supported the campaign into the Yellow River region. Xie Xuan’s story makes logistics visible within a celebrated victory and shows how defence, expansion and transport could become parts of the same military undertaking.
summary.zh: 377年谢玄受命统辖江北军务，将谢氏在朝廷的影响力与东晋防御的实际需要联系起来。383年，他与其他将领共同在淝水击败苻坚的进攻；正史也记录了这些同僚的作用。胜利提供了北进机会，但下一阶段所需的不只有战场胜绩。传记写到谢玄改善水道，使补给能够通过困难地形，支持向黄河地区推进。谢玄的故事让著名胜利背后的后勤工作显现出来，也说明防御、扩张与运输如何成为同一军事行动的组成部分。

title.en: An Lushan · frontier command becomes rebellion
title.zh: 安禄山 · 边镇权力转为叛乱

summary.en: An Lushan rose through the Tang frontier armies and received the Pinglu command in 742. His authority depended on imperial appointments and relationships at court as well as soldiers on the border. In 755 he rose against the dynasty from Fanyang. His armies then took Luoyang, where he claimed an imperial title in 756; the fighting also drove the Tang court from Chang’an. His own rule ended in a palace conspiracy in 757 involving his son An Qingxu and members of his household. The rebellion continued after his death. Following these changing centres of command reveals a struggle within an interconnected empire, not a simple opposition between a capital and an isolated frontier.
summary.zh: 安禄山从唐朝边军中升迁，742年受任平卢节度使。他的权力既来自边境军队，也依靠皇帝任命与朝廷关系。755年，他从范阳起兵反唐。此后的进军夺取洛阳，他于756年在那里称帝；战事也迫使唐廷离开长安。757年，安庆绪与身边人员参与的宫廷密谋结束了他的统治，但叛乱仍在继续。沿着这些变化的指挥中心观察，可以看出这是一场发生在相互联系的帝国内部的权力斗争，而非都城与孤立边地之间的简单对抗。

title.en: Huang Chao · taking a capital, feeding an army
title.zh: 黄巢 · 攻取都城与供应军粮

summary.en: Huang Chao joined an uprising that spread during drought and political disorder in the late Tang. After Wang Xianzhi died in 878, he became the rebels’ leading commander. His forces reached Guangzhou before turning north and occupying Chang’an, where he proclaimed a new dynasty. Possessing a capital did not provide a secure state: disrupted cultivation and contested supply lines made provisions a central problem. The Old Tang History also records killings of officials and residents, challenging any account of an uncomplicated popular liberation. Expelled from Chang’an in 883, Huang died the following year. His campaign connects rural distress, mobile armies and the difficulties of governing a city acquired through war.
summary.zh: 唐末旱灾与政治失序中，黄巢加入了扩展中的反叛。878年王仙芝死后，他成为起义军主要统帅。其军南至广州，又转向北方，进入长安并建立新政权。然而，占有都城并不等于掌握稳固国家：耕作中断、运输争夺使粮食供应成为要害。《旧唐书》还记载了杀害官员与居民的行为，不能将这段历史写成没有矛盾的民众解放。883年黄巢退出长安，次年死亡。他的战争把农村困境、流动作战与战后治理城市的难题联系起来。

title.en: Li Cunxu · a dynasty built through personal loyalties
title.zh: 李存勖 · 私人效忠关系与建国

summary.en: Li Cunxu inherited his father Li Keyong’s position as Prince of Jin in 908 and proclaimed the Later Tang in 923. His regime drew on the Tang name while adapting institutions to the world of competing northern armies. Military households mattered as much as formal offices. Adopted sons and experienced commanders brought networks of loyalty that could strengthen a ruler and also resist him. Historian Richard L. Davis traces such tensions between Cunxu and his adoptive brother Li Siyuan. Conquest did not settle their political relationship. Cunxu died in a soldiers’ mutiny in 926, after only a short imperial reign, making his career a study in the difficult passage from coalition warfare to government.

title.en: Chai Rong · campaigns and the resources of rule
title.zh: 柴荣 · 征战与统治资源

summary.en: Chai Rong, adopted into Guo Wei’s household, became ruler of the Later Zhou in 954. His short reign joined military expansion with decisions about the resources available to government. The annals record temple closures and restrictions on copper in 955, then campaigns against Southern Tang. By 958 the southern campaign had established the Yangtze as the boundary between the two states. These changes affected religious institutions, local revenues and populations caught between armies. A northern campaign followed in 959, but Chai Rong died that year and a child succeeded him. His reign deserves attention as a political project in its own right, rather than merely a preface to the later Song.
summary.zh: 柴荣幼年进入郭威家中并被收为养子，954年成为后周君主。他短暂的统治将军事扩张与国家资源安排联系在一起。本纪记载955年的裁并寺院、铜禁，以及随后对南唐的征战。至958年，南方战事使双方以长江为界。这些变化影响了宗教机构、地方收入与处于军队之间的民众。959年柴荣又率军北上，却在当年去世，由幼子继位。他的统治具有自身的政治目标，不应仅被写成后来宋朝建立的前奏。

title.en: Li Yu · a lost court and a lyric voice
title.zh: 李煜 · 失去的宫廷与词中声音

summary.en: Li Yu inherited Southern Tang in 961, ruling from Jinling within an increasingly constrained relationship with the Song. His court cultivated literature, calligraphy and painting, yet cultural activity did not secure political independence. Song armies took the capital in 975, and Li Yu was brought to Kaifeng. He died in 978. His lasting reputation rests on ci, lyrics composed to established musical patterns. Their images of separation, remembered pleasure and irreversible loss helped make political displacement emotionally legible. Reading these works alongside the annals brings together two kinds of evidence: a victor’s history of a defeated ruler and poetry whose speaking voice cannot always be treated as a literal diary.
summary.zh: 961年，李煜在金陵继承南唐，在与宋朝日益受限的关系中执政。宫廷培养文学、书法与绘画，但文化活动无法保障政治独立。975年宋军攻取都城，李煜被带往开封，978年去世。他流传至今的声名主要来自按既有曲调填写的词。离别、旧日欢愉与无可挽回的失落，使政治上的流离获得可感的情绪。将词与本纪并读，便能看到两类证据：胜利者对亡国之君的历史叙述，以及不能一概当作逐日自传的诗歌声音。

title.en: Han Shizhong · river defence and the limits of command
title.zh: 韩世忠 · 江防与将权的边界

summary.en: Han Shizhong helped restore Emperor Gaozong during the military coup of 1129, then defended the lower Yangtze against Jin forces. The Song History remembers both the pressure his ships placed on the enemy and the eventual Jin escape: the celebrated river campaign was not an uncomplicated annihilating victory. It also gives his wife, Lady Liang, an active role in signalling the fighting. Han opposed the court’s moves toward peace with the Jin. In 1141 his field command was removed, followed by retirement from central military office. He died in 1151. His biography places battlefield initiative beside the political limits imposed on commanders by the government they served.
summary.zh: 1129年兵变中，韩世忠参与恢复宋高宗的皇位，随后在长江下游抵御金军。《宋史》既记述其舰船对敌军的压力，也记述金军最终脱身，因此这场著名江上战事并非毫无转折的歼灭性胜利。传记还写到梁夫人亲自击鼓参与指挥。韩世忠反对朝廷与金议和；1141年，他的野战军权被收回，随后退出中央军政职位，1151年去世。他的经历把战场上的主动权，与朝廷对将领权力的限制并置起来。

title.en: Xu Da · conquest and a continuing frontier
title.zh: 徐达 · 征服与持续的边疆战争

summary.en: Xu Da was one of Zhu Yuanzhang’s principal commanders in the wars that established Ming rule. In 1368 his army entered the Yuan capital, Dadu, after the emperor had withdrawn north. The Ming History emphasizes the securing of government stores and palace buildings, presenting disciplined occupation as part of his reputation. Yet the capture of a capital did not end the military contest. Xu fought Köke Temür near Dingxi in 1370 and suffered a serious defeat during another northern expedition in 1372. Seen together, these episodes show the difference between a dynastic turning point and the continued work of campaigning, garrisoning and defending a frontier against opponents who remained in the field.
summary.zh: 徐达是朱元璋建立明朝战争中的主要统帅之一。1368年，元帝北撤后，他率军进入元都大都。《明史》强调封存府库、保护宫殿等措施，把占领中的纪律写入他的形象。然而，夺取都城并未结束军事较量。1370年徐达在定西附近与扩廓帖木儿交战，1372年再次北征时又遭受严重失败。合看这些经历，可以区分王朝更替的转折点，与此后仍须进行的征战、驻防及应对继续抵抗者的边防工作。

title.en: Nurhaci · households, banners and a new state
title.zh: 努尔哈赤 · 户口、八旗与新政权

summary.en: Nurhaci’s rise rested on organizing people and supplies as well as winning battles. He established his capital at Hetu Ala in 1603, with workshops and stores supporting an expanding Jurchen polity. The banner system joined military service to households and production; its enlargement to eight banners in 1615 made it a framework for society as well as an army. In 1616 he proclaimed himself khan of the Later Jin. Conquests then shifted the state toward the towns and agricultural resources of Liaodong, and in 1625 he moved the capital to Shenyang. These successive centres reveal institutions changing with expansion, before his successor adopted the Qing dynastic name.
summary.zh: 努尔哈赤的崛起不仅靠战胜对手，也靠组织人口与供应。1603年，他在赫图阿拉建立都城，以作坊与仓储支持扩张中的女真政权。八旗体系把军事服役与户口、生产相连；1615年扩为八旗后，它既是军队编制，也是社会组织框架。1616年努尔哈赤称汗，建立后金。此后的征服使政权转向辽东城镇及其农业资源，1625年迁都沈阳。这些先后形成的中心，呈现了后来改称清朝之前，制度随扩张而变化的过程。

title.en: Hong Taiji · remaking the institutions of conquest
title.zh: 皇太极 · 重塑征服政权的制度

summary.en: Hong Taiji succeeded Nurhaci in 1626 within a ruling family whose senior princes held their own banners. He gradually concentrated authority that had previously been shared, while incorporating Chinese officers and Mongol allies into an expanding state. The political community also received new names. In 1635 he ordered the use of Manchu in place of earlier designations; in 1636 he proclaimed the Qing dynasty and assumed an imperial title. These were acts of government and claims to legitimacy, not evidence that a timeless national identity had simply revealed itself. His career connects military coalition building with the deliberate reshaping of institutions, titles and collective belonging.
summary.zh: 1626年皇太极继承努尔哈赤之位，当时宗室中的资深诸王各自拥有旗分。他逐步集中此前分掌的权力，同时把汉人将领与蒙古盟友纳入扩张的国家。政治共同体也获得了新名称：1635年他命令以“满洲”取代旧称，1636年改国号为清并称帝。这些都是治理行动与合法性主张，不能理解为一种自古不变的民族身份自然显露。皇太极的经历把军事联盟的建构，与制度、称号及共同归属的主动重塑联系起来。

title.en: Li Zicheng · rebellion, relief and a brief capital
title.zh: 李自成 · 反叛、赈济与短暂占都

summary.en: Li Zicheng joined Gao Yingxiang’s forces in 1631 and became a leading rebel commander after Gao’s execution in 1636. Famine and the promise of relief helped enlarge his following in Henan; military victory also required turning seized resources into administration. At Xiangyang and then Xi’an, his movement began building the institutions of a rival state. In 1644 he adopted the dynastic name Shun and captured Beijing as Ming authority collapsed. Success lasted only briefly. Wu Sangui’s forces and the Manchus defeated him at Shanhai Pass, forcing a retreat from the capital. His trajectory connects the desperation of regional rebellion with the different demands of holding and governing an empire.

title.en: Yongzheng Emperor · reports, revenue and concentrated authority
title.zh: 雍正帝 · 奏报、财赋与集权

summary.en: The Yongzheng emperor came to the throne in 1722; his reign era began the following year. He sought closer control over officials and provincial finances, combining administrative attention with coercive authority. Fiscal measures brought some informal fees into regulated revenue and supported allowances intended to reduce officials’ reliance on irregular income. The Grand Council, established in 1729, provided another channel for concentrated decision making. These institutional changes belong beside the punishments imposed on rivals and former allies. When Yongzheng died in 1735, his successor inherited a court with strengthened tools for monitoring and directing government across distant provinces.
summary.zh: 雍正帝于1722年即位，次年启用雍正年号。他力求更紧密地控制官员与地方财政，将行政整顿与强制权力结合起来。财政措施把部分非正式收费纳入规范收入，并以养廉银减少官员对额外收入的依赖。1729年设立军机处，又提供了集中决策的渠道。这些制度变化应与惩处政敌、旧臣的行动一并观察。1735年雍正去世时，继任者接手的朝廷已拥有更有力的工具，监察并指挥远方各省的治理。

title.en: Qianlong Emperor · collecting culture, controlling texts
title.zh: 乾隆帝 · 收藏文化与控制文本

summary.en: Qianlong succeeded his father in 1735 and ruled through an expanding court culture of collecting, commissioning and classification. Paintings, calligraphy, gardens and official compilations helped present the emperor as a judge of knowledge and taste. The enormous Siku Quanshu project preserved many texts, while the same court searched for writings it considered hostile to Manchu rule and ordered works altered or destroyed. Cultural patronage and censorship therefore belonged to the same exercise of authority. In 1793 Qianlong received the Macartney embassy but rejected its principal requests for changes to trade arrangements. He formally abdicated in 1796 while continuing to intervene in government, separating the transfer of an imperial title from the surrender of political power.
summary.zh: 乾隆于1735年继承父位，统治伴随着宫廷收藏、委托制作与知识分类的扩展。绘画、书法、园林和官修典籍，将皇帝呈现为学识与品味的裁定者。《四库全书》工程保存大量文本，同一朝廷也搜查被认为敌视满洲统治的著作，命令删改或销毁。文化赞助与文字审查因此属于同一种权力运作。1793年乾隆接见马戛尔尼使团，却拒绝其改变贸易安排的主要要求。1796年他正式退位，仍继续干预政务，皇位名号的移交并不等于政治权力的交出。

title.en: Hong Xiuquan · religious texts and a rival kingdom
title.zh: 洪秀全 · 宗教文本与另立王国

summary.en: Hong Xiuquan reinterpreted earlier visions after reading Christian tracts in 1843, coming to believe that he was Jesus’s younger brother. Preaching in Guangxi helped create the religious movement that became the Taiping challenge to Qing rule. After taking Nanjing in 1853, the Taiping made it their capital, Tianjing, and issued religious instructions alongside plans for government and land. Their publications are evidence of aspirations and prescribed order, not proof that every programme was implemented. Hong’s regime also suffered violent leadership struggles, including the killings of 1856. He died in 1864 before Qing forces captured the capital. His story links the circulation of printed religion to mass mobilization, civil war and contested political authority.
summary.zh: 1843年洪秀全阅读基督教传教书后，重新解释早年的异象，自认为耶稣之弟。在广西的传教活动，促成了后来挑战清朝的太平天国运动。1853年太平军攻取南京，改为都城天京，发布宗教训诫，也提出治理与土地制度方案。这些出版物反映理想和规定秩序，不能据此认定每项方案都已实行。其政权还经历了1856年等暴力领导权斗争。洪秀全于1864年清军攻陷都城之前去世。他的故事把宗教印刷品的流通，与群众动员、内战和政治权威之争联系起来。

title.en: Li Hongzhang · armies, companies and diplomacy
title.zh: 李鸿章 · 军队、企业与外交

summary.en: Li Hongzhang brought his Huai Army to Shanghai in 1862, linking regional military organization with a treaty-port world of foreign weapons and shipping. His later projects extended beyond warfare. He proposed the China Merchants Steam Navigation Company in 1872, and a telegraph line between Tianjin and Shanghai was completed in 1881. Such enterprises combined official backing with commercial investment rather than fitting a simple division between state and private activity. As a senior diplomat, Li also negotiated after military defeat. The Treaty of Shimonoseki in 1895 exposed the limits of the institutions he had helped build. His career connects the practical work of acquiring technology with the unequal pressures surrounding late Qing government.
summary.zh: 1862年李鸿章率淮军到达上海，把地方军事组织与通商口岸的外国武器、航运网络连接起来。此后的事业超出战争：1872年他提议创办轮船招商局，1881年天津至上海的电报线建成。这类企业结合官府支持与商业投资，不能简单归入纯官办或纯私营。作为高级外交官，李鸿章也在军事失败后参与谈判。1895年的《马关条约》显出了他参与建立的制度所面临的限度。他的经历把引进技术的具体工作，与晚清治理所承受的不平等外部压力联系起来。
